assessment_objectives.objective: automated asset discovery tools are deployed to identify Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) connected to organizational networks.
the frequency at which automated asset discovery is performed is defined.
the network scope covered by automated asset discovery is defined and includes all organizational network segments (e.g., wired, wireless, cloud and remote access).
discovered Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) are compared against existing inventories to identify assets not present in the inventory.
assets identified by discovery that are not present in existing inventories are investigated and either added to the inventory or removed from the network within a defined time period.
